info.name: Nafs API — All Endpoints
info.description:
Complete Nafs therapist + client API collection.
Base: {{baseUrl}} (Hostinger: https://myva.ae/api/v1).
Login saves {{token}} automatically.

Synced from src/routes/index.js.
Includes Stripe Checkout, journal ordered blocks[], privacy media upload (disk/Range/purpose/thumbnail), My Plan, FCM, admin config.
Includes Progress tab /progress/summary + insight cache.

request.description: Shows whether Stripe live/test keys are configured (never returns the secret key).
Stores Stripe keys in app_secrets so Hostinger checkout can charge cards.
Legacy Moyasar webhook (fallback when Stripe is not configured).
Stripe webhook. Point Stripe Dashboard to this URL for checkout.session.completed. Server re-fetches the session before confirming.

request.description: Create a journal entry as an ordered blocks[] list (1–50). Upload media first via POST /privacy/media/upload with purpose=journal, then pass media_id. Legacy body/media_url/notes/media still accepted when blocks is omitted.
Upload journal media. Limits: photo 10MB, audio 25MB, video 100MB. Journal-purpose items are excluded from GET /privacy/media. Returns thumbnail_url when thumbnail is sent.
List entries (pinned first, newest). Each item includes block_count and preview_block (not full blocks[]). q also searches text blocks.
Full entry with ordered blocks[]. Legacy body (first text) and media_url (first media) are included for older clients.
Update entry. When blocks[] is present, all blocks are replaced in array order. Omitting blocks leaves existing blocks unchanged. prompt_id is accepted.
Deletes the entry and attached journal media files.
Progress tab cards + ai_input aggregates. has_enough_data is false with fewer than 3 scored check-ins.
Cached AI insight for the current period window, or insight: null.

request.description: Upsert app-generated Progress insight text for this period_start.
Starts Stripe Checkout (live). Response includes pay_url (checkout.stripe.com) and provider: stripe. Open pay_url in a webview, then poll GET /payments/{{bookingId}}/status.
Multipart upload to disk. Size limits: photo 10MB / audio 25MB / video 100MB. Photos for purpose=recording still require facial_emotion_cache consent.
